lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Snow. Peppa and George are very excited today. It is snowing outside. Mummy, can we go and play in the snow?
lines.zh: 下雪了。佩奇和乔治今天特别兴奋。外面下雪了。妈妈，我们能去雪地里玩吗？

lines.en: Yes, but it's very cold outside, so you must wrap up warm.
lines.zh: 可以，不过外面很冷，你们得穿暖和些。

lines.en: Hooray! And don't forget to wear your hats and scarves and gloves. It is very cold outside.
lines.zh: 太好啦！别忘了戴上帽子、围巾和手套。外面非常冷。

lines.en: Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves. Come on, George!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治得戴上帽子、围巾和手套。快点，乔治！

lines.en: Peppa and George are making footprints in the snow.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在雪地上踩脚印。

lines.en: Peppa and George love making footprints in the snow.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在雪地上踩脚印。

lines.en: Oh!
lines.zh: 哦！

lines.en: Oh, dear. It's not funny.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。这一点都不好笑。

lines.en: George, let's play snowballs!
lines.zh: 乔治，我们来打雪仗吧！

lines.en: Peppa has made a snowball. Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
lines.zh: 佩奇团了一个雪球。佩奇和乔治玩得非常开心。

lines.en: George, come back, you little piggy! Oh, dear. Maybe this game is getting a little too rough. Sorry, George.
lines.zh: 乔治，你回来，你这个小猪！哦，天哪。也许这个游戏玩得有点过火了。对不起，乔治。

lines.en: George, let's build a snowman!
lines.zh: 乔治，我们来堆雪人吧！

lines.en: Peppa and George are making a snowman. First, they make the body. George, this is the snowman's body.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在堆雪人。首先，他们做身体。乔治，这是雪人的身体。

lines.en: Now they make the snowman's head. Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
lines.zh: 现在他们做雪人的头。现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

lines.en: George has found some sticks for the snowman's arms. Peppa has found some stones for the snowman's eyes and mouth.
lines.zh: 乔治找了一些树枝当雪人的手臂。佩奇找了一些石头当雪人的眼睛和嘴巴。

lines.en: This is his face. Now the snowman needs a nose.
lines.zh: 这是他的脸。现在雪人还需要一个鼻子。

lines.en: Peppa has got a carrot to make the snowman's nose. The snowman looks very happy. But maybe he is a bit cold. The snowman needs some clothes to keep it warm.
lines.zh: 佩奇拿了一根胡萝卜给雪人做鼻子。雪人看起来很开心。不过他可能有点冷。雪人需要穿点衣服保暖。

lines.en: George has found some clothes to keep the snowman nice and warm. The snowman is wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
lines.zh: 乔治找来了一些衣服，让雪人暖暖和和的。雪人戴上了帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: Mummy, Daddy, come and look!
lines.zh: 妈妈，爸爸，快来看呀！

lines.en: Mummy Pig is wearing her hat and scarf and gloves. That is the best snowman I have ever seen!
lines.zh: 猪妈妈戴着她的帽子、围巾和手套。这是我见过最棒的雪人！

lines.en: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: Daddy, why aren't you wearing your hat and scarf and gloves? I don't know where they are. I can't find them anywhere.
lines.zh: 爸爸，你为什么没戴帽子、围巾和手套？我不知道它们在哪儿。我到处都找不到。

lines.en: I think I know where Daddy's hat, scarf and gloves are.
lines.zh: 我想我知道爸爸的帽子、围巾和手套在哪儿。

lines.en: Daddy Pig's hat and scarf and gloves are on the snowman!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸的帽子、围巾和手套都在雪人身上！
